title: Residual compact Haar averaging gives a stratum-compatible invariant Hilbert sector

haar_projection.operator_control: P0 is self-adjoint, idempotent and norm one, with closed range H_N^U(1)
haar_projection.charge_rule: A polynomial charge monomial survives exactly when its total integer charge is zero
haar_projection.orbit_types: Support gcd d gives stabilizer Z_d, neutral support gives U(1), and gcd-one support is free; Haar projection requires compactness but not freeness
haar_projection.stratum_compatibility: All orbit types contribute through invariant functions without identifying the classical quotient with one free smooth manifold
haar_projection.boundary: Invariant projection does not select the charge generator or normalization and is not a continuum physical-state construction
